about: Negotiation precedent from Project/Dataset/negotiation_notes.md (Jay's unreviewed reconstruction, 26–27 Sep 2026). 'label' marks standard positions vs one-off exceptions so exceptions never become policy (PRD §11).

precedents.asked: Rates no less favourable than any other customer's, incl. Affiliates
precedents.outcome: Accepted as drafted: 'We never discount, so it's harmless.'
precedents.label: exception
precedents.context: AtliQ Inc; rate card Sr DE $85/hr, DE $62/hr, BI Dev $58/hr

precedents.asked: AtliQ indemnifies everything, including PayTrack's own negligence
precedents.outcome: Mutual indemnity (each side covers its own breach/negligence); liability cap stays 1x fees
precedents.label: standard
precedents.context: 'We can't insure against PayTrack's own negligence.'

precedents.asked: Freelancer keeps IP in the Work Product, licenses it to AtliQ
precedents.outcome: Accepted ('ok' from a phone)
precedents.label: exception
precedents.context: Conflicts with Acme MSA 9.1, which assigned the same work to Acme

precedents.asked: 1% of Contract Value per week, no cap
precedents.outcome: 0.5% of the affected milestone fee per week of delay attributable to AtliQ, max 5% of that milestone fee; no LD for client-caused delay
precedents.label: standard

precedents.asked: Worldwide, 3 years
precedents.outcome: GCC only, term + 18 months
precedents.label: exception
precedents.context: Bhavin: 'we'll never do another hotel in the Gulf anyway.'

precedents.asked: 1% of total fees per week, cap 10%
precedents.outcome: 1% per week on the milestone; 10% of total fees cap kept
precedents.label: exception
precedents.context: K: 'Approving 10% of total fees as a strategic exception for Al Noor only, not our new standard.'

precedents.asked: DIFC law and courts
precedents.outcome: Accepted ('group standard for all technology vendors')
precedents.label: exception

precedents.asked: 10% of Contract Value if go-live missed
precedents.outcome: 0.5% per week of the milestone, cap 5% of the milestone, client delays excluded
precedents.label: standard

precedents.asked: English law / LCIA (board policy)
precedents.outcome: Accepted: 'not worth losing the deal over'; IP and boilerplate only skimmed
precedents.label: exception
precedents.context: The skimmed IP clause assigned PipeKit to Northwind

precedents.asked: No competing platform partnership in India, the GCC or Europe
precedents.outcome: India + GCC only; mutual 90-day termination for convenience
precedents.label: standard
precedents.context: 'We can't do Europe; Europe is where we're growing.'

precedents.asked: BAA for US healthcare data
precedents.outcome: Counsel review ($3,800); per-engagement intercompany BAA; only de-identified data offshore
precedents.label: standard

precedents.asked: Agency pushed back on 1%/day delay penalty, 60-day payment, unlimited vendor liability
precedents.outcome: Penalty deleted; 30-day payment; liability capped at fees for both sides
precedents.label: standard
precedents.context: K: 'They're six people. I don't want our paper to be the thing I hate receiving.' Template file possibly never updated.

precedents.asked: Group template, needed by quarter end
precedents.outcome: No redlines; signed from a phone: 'Looks standard, signing now.'
precedents.label: exception
precedents.context: Led to an $18,400 LD claim, $9,000 credit note and $14,200 counsel fees (April 2026 post-mortem)

precedents.asked: Supplier liable without limitation for all damages
precedents.outcome: Walked away; offered 1x fees with carve-outs
precedents.label: standard
precedents.context: 'Unlimited liability on a €120k deal means one bad incident … and the company is gone.'

precedents.asked: Consent under §12 for one Oman project
precedents.outcome: Waiver for the Seaside Hotels SOW only
precedents.label: exception
precedents.context: Each GCC hotel deal needs its own letter

precedents.asked: One-way NDA (only AtliQ bound)
precedents.outcome: Mutual NDA
precedents.label: standard
precedents.context: 'We only sign mutual; we'll be sharing our architecture too.'

precedents.asked: Their 'standard' NDA, needed that night
precedents.outcome: Signed within the hour, no changes (it was one-way, with a no-hire clause)
precedents.label: exception

precedents.asked: Payment in 90 days
precedents.outcome: 45 days
precedents.label: standard

precedents.asked: 2% of Contract Value per week, cap 10% of total
precedents.outcome: 0.5% of milestone fee per week, cap 5% of milestone, client delays excluded
precedents.label: standard

precedents.asked: NDA so scoping could start
precedents.outcome: Signed next day, nothing discussed
precedents.label: unknown

history.detail: Milestone 2 slipped ~3 weeks after Brightwater gave warehouse access 19 days late; their UK lawyers claimed $18,400 in LDs.
Settled with a $9,000 credit note (settlement letter 20 Apr 2026); Calloway Stern billed $14,200.
Payment terms negotiated from 90 to 45 days before signing; no late payments recorded.
Their legal team has had AtliQ's markup since 18 Aug 2026 with no reply (deal, not payment).
Deal lost over unlimited liability; no contract signed.
